scope: Every partial/not-found/not-implemented row in the original audit. Existing library/CLI capabilities are not falsely relabeled as missing.

items.capability: Six-dimensional data quality framework
items.baseline_evidence: `core/quality.py::quality_score` exposes completeness, validity, uniqueness, regularity. The weighted score is 40/20/10/30 percent respectively. No six-axis accuracy/consistency/timeliness framework is established by this score.

items.capability: Accuracy against an external source of truth
items.baseline_evidence: Range checks, outliers, and plausibility scores do not establish measurement accuracy against a verified reference.

items.capability: General cross-column / cross-table consistency rules
items.baseline_evidence: `core/schema.py`, `core/integrity.py`, temporal quantity semantics and leakage rules; no general-purpose rule DSL found.

items.capability: Freshness / SLA timeliness scoring
items.baseline_evidence: Gap/regularity detection is present; that is not a wall-clock freshness SLA engine.

items.capability: Arbitrary business validation suite / Pandera or Great Expectations execution
items.baseline_evidence: Product schema/integrity validation is custom and narrower. Dependency presence would not establish execution.

items.capability: Mean/mode/general categorical imputation APIs
items.baseline_finding: Not found as a general catalog
items.baseline_evidence: The predictor-specific policies above are not a complete arbitrary tabular imputation framework.

items.capability: Learned string normalization, fuzzy deduplication, entity resolution
items.baseline_evidence: File ingestion and column-name handling are not these capabilities.

items.capability: One-sample KS / Lilliefors normality
items.baseline_evidence: KS drift is not a substitute for these normality tests.

items.capability: Ordinary pooled two-sample t, one-sample t, paired t, Wilcoxon signed-rank, sign test
items.baseline_finding: Not found as dedicated general tests
items.baseline_evidence: A t-based confidence interval is not evidence of these separate test APIs.

items.capability: Repeated-measures ANOVA, two-way/factorial ANOVA, ANCOVA, MANOVA, Tukey HSD, Dunn
items.baseline_evidence: Do not equate Nemenyi with every post-hoc procedure.

items.capability: Pearson / Spearman / Kendall associations
items.baseline_evidence: Descriptive coefficients and MI in `core/eda.py`, Kendall inference is gated, Pearson p-values in `core/cache.py`; not one uniform correlation API with all alternatives and CIs.

items.capability: Chi-square contingency, Fisher exact, McNemar, Cochran Q
items.baseline_evidence: A chi-square distribution used for Mahalanobis thresholds or another diagnostic does not implement contingency testing.

items.capability: Sidak, Holm-Sidak, Hochberg, Hommel, two-stage FDR
items.baseline_evidence: Not implied by using statsmodels elsewhere.

items.capability: General power/sample-size design workbench
items.baseline_evidence: Assumption/sample-size gates exist; no general prospective power-analysis interface established. Retrospective observed power is explicitly rejected by test contracts.

items.capability: Bayesian posterior inference, MCMC, variational inference, Bayesian model averaging
items.baseline_evidence: Bayesian Ridge and Gaussian process candidates exist, but do not establish a general MCMC/variational-inference/model-averaging workbench.

items.capability: Financial VaR, CVaR / expected shortfall, drawdown, portfolio risk
items.baseline_evidence: Savings uncertainty and deviation alerts are not financial risk analytics.

items.capability: Jensen-Shannon/KL divergence, categorical chi-square drift, ADWIN, DDM, EDDM
items.baseline_evidence: Not established by the numeric drift implementation.

items.capability: Demographic parity, equalized odds, disparate impact, subgroup fairness mitigation
items.baseline_evidence: Causal group covariate balance is not algorithmic fairness.

items.capability: General adversarial robustness / stress-testing suite
items.baseline_evidence: Leakage canaries, validity-domain checks, plausibility and sensitivity diagnostics are narrower safeguards.

items.capability: RFE / RFECV, Boruta, sequential forward/backward selection, genetic selection
items.baseline_evidence: Ranking or an AUTO heuristic does not implement these algorithms.

items.capability: Multi-target feature consensus
items.baseline_evidence: `models/f8_regime.py` has Kendall-W feature consensus; this is not evidence of a general multi-output consensus selector.

items.capability: General RobustScaler / MinMax / power transforms / learned categorical encoding / target encoding
items.baseline_finding: Not found as a general feature pipeline
items.baseline_evidence: Not implied by sklearn being installed.

items.capability: Feature hashing / text TF-IDF / language embeddings / image embeddings
items.baseline_evidence: Numeric dimensionality reduction is not NLP/CV embedding support.

items.capability: Median / last-value / seasonal-naive / random-walk baseline catalog
items.baseline_finding: Not found as dedicated main candidates
items.baseline_evidence: ETS or seasonal decomposition does not establish these separate benchmark models.

items.capability: Huber/RANSAC robust regression, kNN regression and arbitrary standalone decision-tree regression
items.baseline_finding: Not found as dedicated main candidates
items.baseline_evidence: kNN classification in mining and trees inside ensembles are different capabilities.

items.capability: Auto-sklearn, TPOT, H2O, FLAML, AutoGluon, NAS
items.baseline_evidence: Optuna-backed tuning does not mean these AutoML engines are integrated.

items.capability: TFT, PatchTST, Informer / general Transformer forecasting
items.baseline_finding: Not implemented in main candidate registry
items.baseline_evidence: `core/models.py` explicitly records TFT and PatchTST/Informer as unavailable architectures.

items.capability: VAR / VECM, TBATS / BATS, Croston intermittent demand, hierarchical reconciliation
items.baseline_evidence: Not implied by statsmodels or decomposition capabilities.

items.capability: DeepAR, N-HiTS, TiDE, foundation forecasting models
items.baseline_evidence: N-BEATS is implemented; do not extrapolate that to every deep forecasting architecture.

items.capability: General supervised classification product
items.baseline_evidence: `core/mining.py` has logistic/RF/ExtraTrees/GB/SVM/kNN/NB/MLP and optional boosting regime classifiers. This does not provide arbitrary classification targets, classification lifecycle, or a fairness workbench in the main regression product.

items.capability: General anomaly detection
items.baseline_evidence: See outlier methods above and descriptive `core/mining.py`; no comprehensive anomaly model zoo.

items.capability: Survival / Cox / AFT / Kaplan-Meier / competing risks
items.baseline_evidence: No production survival workflow identified.

items.capability: Graph analytics / GNN / node classification / link prediction
items.baseline_evidence: A pipeline dependency DAG is not graph machine learning.

items.capability: NLP classification / NER / sentiment / translation / summarization / topic modeling / LLM or RAG
items.baseline_evidence: Numeric report narratives are not a general NLP subsystem.

items.capability: Image classification / detection / segmentation / OCR / vision models
items.baseline_evidence: Plotting and a 1D numeric CNN are not computer vision.

items.capability: Recommenders / collaborative filtering / matrix factorization / ranking
items.baseline_evidence: Model leaderboard ranking is not recommendation-system learning-to-rank.

items.capability: Causal forests / generalized CATE model zoo / IV / RD / synthetic control / causal discovery
items.baseline_evidence: The optional LinearDML adapter is not evidence for these separate algorithms.

items.capability: General LP/MILP, scheduling, routing, multi-objective / Pareto / evolutionary optimization
items.baseline_evidence: Task-specific numerical minimization is not a general operations-research platform.

items.capability: General discrete-event, agent-based, system-dynamics simulation / digital twins
items.baseline_evidence: Bootstrap and Monte Carlo test calibration are not these simulators.

items.capability: LIME, ALE, counterfactual explanations, recourse, causal explanations
items.baseline_evidence: PDP/ICE or a surrogate does not establish these distinct explanation techniques.
